claims.statement: You write a program once in one clear blueprint, and the computer generates matching code in many languages.
Every possible input must have a declared outcome up front, leaving nowhere for silent crashes to hide.
Once a repair passes every check, the engine saves and reuses it so nobody pays twice for one bug.

easy_read.easy_title: One Clear Blueprint for Many Code Languages
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about one clear blueprint for many code languages.
You write a program once in one clear blueprint, and the computer generates matching code in many languages.
Every possible input must have a declared outcome up front, leaving nowhere for silent crashes to hide.
Once a repair passes every check, the engine saves and reuses it so nobody pays twice for one bug.
Key result: 2,221 Checks, 0 Failures · 49 mJ per Check.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
